statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R) →
      2 * ↑π * I * iteratedDeriv n f c = ↑n.factorial * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)

goal.text: 2 * ↑π * I * iteratedDeriv n f c = ↑n.factorial * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)
goal.rhs: ↑n.factorial * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)

atoms: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)
